prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universal “best” HVAC company for AC repair in Houston — the right choice depends on your location, budget, urgency (same‑day or emergency service?), the equipment brand, and whether you want extended warranties or a maintenance plan. That said, I can help you find a top local option.

Before I suggest specific companies, a few quick tips for choosing the best contractor:
- Verify license & insurance: ask for their Texas HVAC/contractor license number and proof of insurance.  
- Look for tech certifications: NATE-certified technicians are a good sign.  
- Read recent local reviews (Google, Yelp, Angi, BBB) and check how the company responds to complaints.  
- Ask about warranties: parts, labor, and any satisfaction guarantees.  
- Get a written estimate that breaks down parts, labor, and diagnostic fees.  
- Ask about flat-rate pricing vs. time-and-materials, and emergency/same-day fees.  
- Check experience with your brand of AC (e.g., Trane, Carrier, Rheem).  
- Watch for red flags: no written estimate, pressure to replace without diagnostics, unmarked trucks or technicians, or cash-only requests.

Well-known companies that operate in Houston (often with good local reputations) include John Moore Services, ARS/Rescue Rooter, and One Hour/Benjamin Franklin (franchises vary by location). I can’t say one is absolutely “best” without knowing where you are and what you need, but those are common starting points.

If you want, tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether you need emergency service — I’ll give 3–5 well-reviewed local options and a suggested script of questions to ask when you call.
